correctness.rationale: The full rational FPT transform for the exact stochastic model is written explicitly. The invariant high-s exponent determines integer protein threshold and leading coefficient determines basal birth rate. For noncoincident rates, explicitly nonzero Laurent coefficients show pole multiplicities lambda and lambda+N-1; at coincident rates the positive coefficient gives multiplicity lambda+N. The sole undecided labeling occurs for N=1, where the next Laurent coefficient distinguishes swaps for all lambda>=2 by a strictly signed sum; lambda=1 has an exact twofold symmetric transform. Lambda=1 is a separate homogeneous-Poisson boundary. The proof and 40 symbolic pole cases, nine exact polynomial identities, and three independent chain resolvents were checked using the package check.py. No finite test is used to establish the universal result.
